result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Our Neighbourhood Administration - Scheduling Officer is a key support role to the delivery of our Community Care based services. You'll play a pivotal role in ensuring business operations are running efficiently and our clients receive an exceptional experience.

Administration - Scheduling Officer | BlueCare | Community Care

Employment Status: Permanent Full Time

Located in: Townsville

Remuneration: $33.22 p-hr + Super + Not for Profit Salary Packaging (Increases your take home pay) + Employee discounts

Make a meaningful difference with BlueCare 

We're looking for someone who wants to build meaningful relationships and make a difference in the lives of others - through small moments that leave big impacts. 

Key responsibilities include but are limited to:

Supporting and coordinating different teams within each neighbourhood

Be the first point of contact for internal and external customers - via phone, email and in person

Manage requests, concerns and inquiries 

Rostering and scheduling support for the neighbourhood

Creation of correspondence and documentation as requested

Efficiently organise appointments, diaries, travel and meeting-workshop preparatory arrangements.

Monitor, order and distribute office supplies and arrange for the maintenance-repair of office equipment

Ensure the integrity and accuracy of information in financial, human resource and other Blue Care systems and databases

Use mainstream software including the Microsoft Office Suite and database applications (Intermediate - Advanced skills required)

Assist senior staff with special projects as required 

We encourage our team to be creative and enjoy themselves while contributing to our success. Come join one of the most trusted community and residential care providers in Australia.

Role requirements: 

You will have effective verbal and written communication skills

Previous experience in rostering-scheduling - Highly regarded 

Great time-management skills and an ability to prioritise your workload

Good knowledge and experience with MS Office and Database applications

Confidence with smart phone and digital devices or willingness to learn

Excellent time management skills and ability to prioritise workloads with a can-do attitude

Employee Benefits: 

Save tax and increase your take home pay by salary packaging your everyday living expenses and bills (up to $15,900) and meal entertainment (up to $2,650) per annum 

A recognition and rewards platform, providing employee discounts at hundreds of retailers, including everyday expenses, holidays, health insurance, annual awards celebration, wellbeing and employee assistance programs 

12 weeks paid parental leave and 2 weeks paid partner leave, available after 6 months service, in addition to the government scheme 

Diversity and inclusive leave, offering paid gender affirmation leave and cultural leave options (paid and unpaid) for those who may celebrate Lunar New Year, Diwali, Ramadan, NAIDOC weeks and other significant cultural events 

Career development opportunities with one of the most trusted community and residential care providers in Australia to challenge yourself, grow and make a meaningful difference 

BlueCare is proudly part of the UnitingCare Family, we'd love you to be too

Joining the state's largest network of aged care workers with its over 8,000 strong, bright team in blue, you'll also be welcomed as part of the UnitingCare family. With more than 16,500 staff and 9,000 volunteers across our brands of BlueCare, Lifeline, ARRCS, The Wesley Hospital, Buderim Private Hospital, St Stephen's Hospital, and St Andrew's War Memorial Hospital, you are part of something bigger. Our team are compassionate, inclusive and committed to the work we do, helping people live life in all its fullness.

Child safe, Child friendly 

UnitingCare is committed to being a Child Safe, Child Friendly organisation and will: 

Provide welcoming, safe & nurturing services for children 

Implement measures to prevent child abuse and neglect within our services

Appropriately and immediately address child abuse and neglect if it does occur 

Abide by the Child Safe Standards and adhere to the Reportable Conduct Scheme 

Diversity & Inclusion 

Our approach is simple -everybody is welcome here. At UnitingCare, diversity is at the core of our who we are, our mission and our values. We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all employees no matter their sex, race, culture, sexual orientation, disability or gender identity. Demonstrating our commitment to reconciliation and building long-term employment opportunities for First Nations peoples, UnitingCare strongly encourages Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants for this position. For additional support and to meet our RAP Team, email reconciliation@ucareqld.com.au

Safe workplace 

We work hard to make our services welcoming and safe for every person. We are united in keeping children, young people and the elderly safe from harm, within our services, workplaces and the communities we support. We are committed to speaking up loudly for their safety.

Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed in creating services and workplaces that are welcoming and safe for every person. We work together to protect children, young people, adults and the elderly from harm within our services and the communities we support. We speak up for their safety to ensure their voices are heard. Our recruitment and workplace practices reflect our dedication in preventing abuse, harm and exploitation across UnitingCare.    Click here to Apply now →

## Telecommunications Technical Officer / Technologist
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Telecommunications Technical Officer or Technologist to join our team and contribute to the delivery of reliable, high-performance telecommunications infrastructure. This role is responsible for the design, installation, maintenance, and optimisation of complex communication networks and systems across a range of technologies. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on technical experience, strong analytical capability, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. This position suits a proactive professional who is committed to maintaining the highest standards of network performance and service delivery.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain microwave, satellite, telemetry, and other radio and electromagnetic communication systems, ensuring all equipment operates to specification and within regulatory requirements.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve network faults, performance issues, and equipment malfunctions in a timely and effective manner, minimising disruption to services.
- Integrate telecommunications networks with computer hardware, software platforms, operating systems, databases, and peripheral devices to ensure seamless end-to-end functionality.
- Monitor the ongoing performance of complex networks and communication systems, identifying trends, anomalies, and areas for optimisation before they impact service quality.
- Plan and support the development of customer access network infrastructure, contributing to capacity planning, design reviews, and upgrade programmes.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation including inventory logs, equipment records, asset statuses, and communication policies, procedures, and quality standards in accordance with organisational and regulatory guidelines.
- Provide clear technical advice and support to internal stakeholders, project teams, and end users on telecommunications systems, configurations, and best practices.
- Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and external service providers to coordinate procurement, installation activities, and ongoing service delivery, whilst monitoring contractual performance and obligations.
- Support the design and optimisation of network architecture, contributing technical input to projects aimed at improving reliability, scalability, and performance.
- Conduct routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and equipment testing to ensure network integrity and compliance with applicable standards.
- Assist in the development and review of technical documentation, including network diagrams, standard operating procedures, and incident reports.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on telecommunications projects, providing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle from scoping through to commissioning and handover.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A diploma, advanced diploma, or bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent industry experience in lieu of formal qualifications.
- Demonstrated experience in a telecommunications technical role, with hands-on exposure to radio frequency (RF), microwave, satellite, or fixed-line communication systems.
- Solid understanding of network protocols, telecommunications standards, and systems integration principles.
- Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting network hardware, software, and associated technologies including switches, routers, and transmission equipment.
- Experience with network monitoring tools and fault management systems, with the ability to interpret performance data and take corrective action.
- Strong documentation skills with the ability to maintain accurate records, produce technical reports, and adhere to quality and compliance standards.
- Effective communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work methodically under pressure, and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes.
- A valid Australian driver's licence, as field-based work and site visits may be required.
- Willingness to participate in an on-call roster or undertake out-of-hours work when operational requirements demand.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent telecommunications qualifications.
- Experience working with microwave backhaul systems, fibre optic networks, or mobile network infrastructure (2G/3G/4G/5G).
- Familiarity with Australian telecommunications regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements, including those governed by the ACMA.
- Exposure to project management methodologies and experience contributing to telecommunications infrastructure projects.
- Knowledge of ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed services or enterprise network environment.
- Postgraduate qualifications in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related discipline.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and highly skilled engineering team working on critical telecommunications infrastructure that makes a real difference to communities and businesses across Australia.
- Enjoy genuine opportunities for professional development, including access to industry training, certifications, and career progression pathways within the organisation.
- Benefit from a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, with options for hybrid arrangements where operational requirements allow.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation contributions, and access to additional employee benefits including wellness programmes and paid leave entitlements.
- Work on a diverse range of projects and technologies that will broaden your technical expertise and keep you at the forefront of the evolving telecommunications landscape.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

Cox Purtell  Digital Marketing & E-commerce Manager 
   
 St Leonards, Sydney | Hybrid (1-2 days WFH) | $170k inclusive super + 10% STI 
   
 The Role: 
   
 This is a well-established, product-led business in the health, beauty and wellbeing space, with a strong retail/clinic network and a fast-growing digital and eCommerce arm. As they continue to scale their online presence, they're looking for a Digital Marketing & E-commerce Manager to take ownership of digital growth and bring real strategic rigour to the function. 
   
 This is a standalone position reporting directly to the Head of Digital. You won't be managing a team - instead, you'll be hands-on, resourceful, and the driving force behind the organisation's digital sales growth. You'll bring the discipline and structure of a larger organisation into a business that's ready to professionalise its digital function further. 
   
 Responsibilities: 
   
 
 Own the performance of the online marketplace and brand websites, driving traffic, conversion, AOV and repeat purchase. 
 Lead the digital media investment strategy across paid social, search, programmatic and affiliate, with clear accountability for ROI and attribution. 
 CRM is central to this role. You'll own database growth, segmentation, automated lifecycle journeys, and loyalty programs that drive retention. 
 Own the digital promotional calendar and digital-specific campaign levers, briefing and guiding creative development. 
 Drive organic visibility and continuous CRO/UX improvement across digital properties. 
 Work closely with Sales, Brand, Customer Service and the wider retail/clinic network to ensure digital activity supports, rather than competes with the broader business. 
 Provide meaningful input into broader digital strategy and commercial planning, working closely with the Head of Digital. 
 
   
 What we're looking for: 
   
 
 Prior experience in Shopify (preferred but not essential) 
 Experience in a product-based business, ideally within healthcare, wellbeing, beauty or a related consumer space. 
 A confident individual owning database growth, segmentation and lifecycle automation. 
 A track record in digital marketing and eCommerce, with solid commercial and analytical acumen. 
 Excellent stakeholder management skills and able to build trust and influence across a diverse business. 
 Comfortable owning a standalone function without a team around you. 
 Ideally, you've worked within a larger, more structured organisation and can bring that discipline to a growing business. 
 Looking for a step up in your career, ready to take full ownership of a high-impact, high-visibility role.
